rows.note: Use 反 as the concise everyday description when an object or flag has been turned upside down.

example.english: You hung the picture upside down.
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 soeng2 gwaa3 faan2 zo2 wo3

rows.note: Choose 亂晒龍 when a room, place, or situation has been thrown into complete disorder rather than physically inverted.

example.english: You’ve turned the whole house upside down.
example.traditional: 成間屋畀你哋搞到亂晒龍喇。
example.jyutping: seng4 gaan1 uk1 bei2 nei5 dei6 gaau2 dou3 lyun6 saai3 lung4 laa3

rows.note: Use 反 for an object, letter, or design that has been physically inverted; it is the all-purpose choice here.

example.english: Someone pasted the poster upside down.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 bei2 jan4 tip3 faan2 zo2

rows.note: Use 亂晒龍 for a place or situation that is in complete chaos rather than physically inverted.

example.english: After Ming moved house, the whole place was upside down.
example.traditional: 阿明搬完屋，成間屋亂晒龍。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 bun1 jyun4 uk1 seng4 gaan1 uk1 lyun6 saai3 lung4
